one_liner: Consensus offers a self-serve REST scholarly paper search API (free tier of 30 calls/month) with API key and OAuth 2.0 PKCE, plus an official hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 auth code + PKCE (S256), scope 'search', DCR gives public clients; confidential clients provisioned on request or via Access Credentials in the web app. API key via x-api-key header is simplest self-serve.
access_notes: Every plan including Free gets API access; Free has 30 calls/month, 1 req/s, 20 papers per request, no pagination or full-text excerpts.
blocker_notes: Free tier quota is small (30 calls/month); the API surface is narrow (search, citations/references beta, threads).

evidence.quote: Authorization-code flow only. There is no client-credentials grant, so OAuth always involves a per-user consent step; each user signs in to their own Consensus account.
Pass the key in the `x-api-key` header. Requests without a valid key return `401`.
Every plan includes API access, and the Free plan includes 30 calls a month.
The API is self-serve on every Consensus plan.
The Consensus API lets you search 400+ million scholarly articles, including 350 million peer-reviewed research papers, over a single REST endpoint.
The official Consensus MCP server gives Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Perplexity and any other MCP client semantic search
